metadata.description: 自建国内插件源：聚合火山引擎、腾讯云 CloudBase、百度智能云、SumSec 中文技能，并提供腾讯云/阿里云搜索 MCP。

plugins.name: tencent-yuanbao-search
plugins.description: 腾讯云元宝联网搜索（SearchPro）远程 MCP。免密可完成握手，调用工具需要腾讯云联网搜索 API Key。

plugins.name: dashscope-websearch
plugins.description: 阿里云百炼 WebSearch 远程 MCP。需要在连接器凭据中填入 DashScope API Key。

plugins.name: volcengine-core
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Core Volcengine discovery, documentation search, CLI operations, troubleshooting, and voluntary community feedback skills.

plugins.name: volcengine-storage
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Operate Volcengine storage products and data with product-specific tools.

plugins.name: volcengine-database
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Build and operate database-backed applications on Volcengine managed database platforms.

plugins.name: volcengine-containers-middleware
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Deploy and manage Volcengine serverless, container, and middleware application runtimes.

plugins.name: volcengine-security
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Assess security and compliance posture, query audit logs, and manage CloudTrail for Volcengine accounts and resources.

plugins.name: volcengine-identity-access-control
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Design and establish Volcengine landing zones, organizations, identity, account factories, and governance baselines.

plugins.name: volcengine-service-support
plugins.description: 火山引擎：Route product transactions (purchase, price enquiry, unsubscribe), prepare and deploy applications, manage infrastructure as code, explore OpenAPI specifications, and generate runnable SDK exampl

plugins.name: cloudbase
plugins.description: 腾讯云：CloudBase platform capabilities: AI, auth, databases, cloud functions, storage, CloudRun, and Mini Program integration.

plugins.name: cloudbase-sites
plugins.description: 腾讯云：Create, preview, save, deploy, inspect, and roll back Vite web apps hosted on Tencent CloudBase.

plugins.name: aihc-eval
plugins.description: 百度智能云：百舸模型评测工具集：把自定义推理服务改造成具身评测可用的 Model Server（用户自定义镜像接入）等评测场景能力。

plugins.name: aihc-eval-openapi
plugins.description: 百度智能云：百舸具身评测 OpenAPI 实践：以苏州地域为例，给出评测任务的调用顺序、签名与幂等、CreateEmbodiedEval 请求体（预置模型、自有权重、自有镜像、全托管资源池）、结果与回放视频读取和常见报错排查。

plugins.name: cloudflare-email
plugins.description: SumSec 中文技能：Cloudflare temp mail agent skill for reading inbox messages, fetching parsed mail, and sending email with an Address JWT.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: SumSec 中文技能：Frontend design taste skills for distinctive layouts, redesigns, image-to-code, brand systems, and visual direction.

plugins.name: semantic-linter
plugins.description: SumSec 中文技能：Detects semantic trap words and wide-boundary wording in Skill, Prompt, and Agent instruction files.
